# Catalog Agent

Use skill `catalog` and read the baseline handoff in root `plan.md`. Analyze existing Angular present/category components, routes, models, services, backend read endpoints, and frontend instructions. Produce a detailed gated sub-plan and wait for explicit approval before modifying code.

Keep the catalogue read-only and use verified API contracts. Do not infer unavailable donor, buyer, purchase, or winner data. Validate service requests and success, empty, loading, error, filter, and detail states.
